title: Store Update 1.40.0
body:
# Store Update 1.40.0

Raiders,

Store Update 1.40.0 is now live, bringing two new colour variants — black and yellow — for the Volare outfit, along with a brand new event called Phantom Targets.

We've noted your reports about the Queen and Matriarch stomp damage hitting players through walls and from excessive distances. A fix is being worked on, and we will share more details once it is ready. We are also investigating the error codes that some players encounter when starting the game on PC.

# **Phantom Targets Event**

Shani has spotted some inconsistent surveillance data but hasn't yet traced where it's coming from. As always, Raiders, it's up to you to head out and look into these odd readings. Repair the broken Antennas to triangulate the signals, and confront the ARC using unconventional tactics in the first half of the new Phantom Targets Player Project. The second half of the Project arrives with Update 1.42 on August 18, alongside the Phantom Targets Event itself.

# **Embark Summer Celebration**

Brush off the dust of the Rust Belt and head into The Arena of THE FINALS!

We've noticed the strong response to the Azimuth Outfit, with many Raiders going full tactical Topside — and now you can bring that same look into THE FINALS. As part of the ongoing Summer Celebration across Embark's games, playing three hours of ARC Raiders will unlock the Azimuth outfit in THE FINALS.

# **Wishlist the Tick Hunter Set**

The Rust Belt is home to many predators, but none match the patience and focus of the Tick Hunter. Visit Steam to wishlist this bundle, which becomes available on all storefronts starting August 18.

The bundle includes the following content:

* Outfit - Tick Hunter (Red, White, Green, Black)

* Backpack - Field Telephone

* Backpack Charm - Tick Trophy

* Face Style - Spider Tattoo

* 2400 Raider Tokens

See you Topside, //Ossen
